uiKit.note: FlClash v0.9.3 moved lib/ui/ into the plugins/prism_ui submodule at this commit.

previousReference.note: The Flutter UI in flutter/ was first imported from these v0.9.2 sources; later pages and components follow v0.9.3 + prism_ui 63450c0.

changes: Dart package imports renamed from fl_clash to fk_box_ui. prism_ui 63450c0 is vendored under packages/prism_ui (FlClash v0.9.3 keeps it as a submodule); FK-box adds the PrismStyle switches (corner scale, shadows vs hairlines, ink spread, sparkle, elastic press) that the appearance 'minimal' style sets, used by banner, dialog, edit_menu, liquid_glass, navigation_dock, page_transition, popup, press_surface, scroll, shape, sidebar, switch and text_field; LinearProgressIndicator also takes a fill color (terminal transfer errors); the hashes in files are of those edited copies. No Clash core included.

lib/components/profile_panel.dart.changes: Mobile profile summary, update and profile-switch controls. Shows compact Room update times with full-date tooltips for local and remote profiles, retaining an unknown placeholder when absent. Remote sessions omit local profile metadata. Counts describe the actual sing-box configuration, with unavailable remote counts left unknown. Disable the profile-switch control during native service start/stop transitions.

lib/pages/profile_details.dart.changes: Profile summary and configuration editing page labeled Edit, with count presentation adapted to live Room metadata and unknown update times explicitly labeled. Metadata editing and advanced/raw sing-box configuration entries are retained. Clash subscription counters are not invented.

lib/components/proxy_groups_panel.dart.changes: Mobile group count, overlapping badges and timeout count adapted to sing-box groups.

lib/components/start_toggle.dart.changes: Flutter presentation preserved; application state and actions use FK-box callbacks.

lib/components/shape_badge.dart.changes: Flutter presentation preserved; application state and actions use FK-box callbacks.

lib/components/connected_buttons.dart.changes: Flutter presentation preserved; application state and actions use FK-box callbacks.

lib/pages/dashboard.dart.changes: NetworkSpeedCard and SpeedTile layout adapted to sing-box traffic samples; traffic tiles subscribe independently from other dashboard cards. Other cards use FK-box capability state. The capability-gated SystemProxyPanel uses the shared editable card order and visibility preferences.

lib/pages/proxies.dart.changes: Proxy card metrics, text, selection and delay presentation adapted to libbox groups. Only selector groups expose selection; Mihomo pinning and local-provider actions are omitted.

lib/pages/profiles.dart.changes: Anchored add menu with a New profile entry, grouped metadata form, selected-item reveal, adaptive grid, flat profile actions and decorated reorder sheet. Edit opens the configuration editing page with raw content access; copy link, QR code, share and export are direct menu actions. Imports and edits retain sing-box JSON, binary/QRS metadata and Room operations; preserve local/remote type conversion, clipboard import, a 15-minute Android update minimum and serialized native updates. No Mihomo custom generator, providers, overrides, age key or runtime-preview claim. Disable configuration selection in both the page and picker during native service start/stop transitions, and recheck current state when a press callback runs.

lib/components/theme_preview.dart.changes: Android appearance presentation adapted to FK-box preferences; shared theme preview and color picker retained. Desktop-only controls omitted.

lib/components/palette.dart.changes: Android appearance presentation adapted to FK-box preferences; shared theme preview and color picker retained. Desktop-only controls omitted.

lib/pages/appearance.dart.changes: Android appearance presentation adapted to FK-box preferences; shared theme preview and color picker retained. Desktop-only controls omitted.

lib/components/status_panel.dart.changes: Mobile header, intrinsic runtime column, caption/figure styles, readable IP fitting, country badge states and decoration clipping retained. Reads native sing-box session and routed IP/quality data; route observation excludes traffic and memory notifications. Unavailable stopped/remote data stays explicit.

lib/components/memory_panel.dart.changes: Mobile memory figure, segmented bar, legend and details. Reads Go runtime statistics from libbox and subtracts them from shared-process RSS. Card and details share a visibility-controlled native sampling subscription and rebuild on memory updates.

lib/components/intranet_panel.dart.changes: Mobile LAN IP, sharing switch, cookie/circle Wi-Fi badge, adaptive row and compact switch track from intranet_ip.dart/card.dart. Copy retains DashboardIconButton's fixed 32px square, 18px glyph, zero padding, surface-variant foreground and 8px right translation. Sharing changes native sing-box proxy inbound listen fields with independent ports and existing authentication/TLS. Copy expands actual running binds to device endpoints; stopped and remote sessions retain device IP copying.

lib/components/system_proxy_panel.dart.changes: VpnCard mobile padding, 48px cookie/circle badge, title and enabled/disabled subtitle, whole-card tap and compact DashboardSwitch layout retained. Uses FK-box's original continent globe glyph from system_proxy_glyph.dart and system HTTP proxy state/command instead of the VPN setting.

lib/components/dashboard_chip.dart.changes: Shared status and quality chips, using the same surface and semantic color roles.

lib/components/group_tabs.dart.changes: Group chip strip, lazy variable-width layout, overflow menu, edge fade and selected-group reveal retained; names come from sing-box groups.

lib/components/record.dart.changes: Shared log/connection/request record surfaces, header, timestamp, labels, typography and copyable detail rows retained; semantic color roles copied from the reference RecordTone enum. Detail rows constrain long labels and support stacked HTTP URLs, headers and cookies while retaining tap-to-copy feedback.

lib/pages/tools.dart.changes: Android section order and glyphs adapted to Flutter pages for supported sing-box configuration and FK-box tools.

lib/pages/about.dart.changes: Hero geometry, version and license pills, update control and link badges retained with FK-box branding and FK-box release metadata.

lib/components/proxy_list.dart.changes: Pinned rounded group headers, fixed-extent lazy rows, folding motion and group controls adapted to real sing-box groups. Fold state persists per profile; no external group icon URLs are invented.

lib/components/proxy_card.dart.changes: Shared card metrics and node interactions for tabs and list rows. Selection is available only for selectable sing-box groups.

lib/components/group_monogram.dart.changes: Group-name monogram and typography retained; empty names use the existing proxy glyph.

lib/components/dashboard_editor.dart.changes: In-place live cards, sway, long-press reordering, remove badges, presence motion and addable rows retained, including the FK-box system HTTP proxy card with FK-box's original continent globe glyph. Saves native preferences, preserves card keys and retries failed saves before leaving.

lib/components/form.dart.changes: Grouped rows and end-aligned text/secret fields retained. Uses the inherited FK-box measurement scope and local error handling.

lib/pages/backup.dart.changes: Remote/local sections, WebDAV form, connectivity indicator, restore scopes and strategy adapted to bounded bbox-1 backups. Waits for native writes and preserves edits on error.

lib/common/ip_quality.dart.changes: Source URLs, parsers, wave order, explicit and inferred types, flags and quality rules preserved; Dio replaced by a cancellable sing-box transport.

lib/common/ip_quality_models.dart.changes: Immutable model, JSON serialization and quality-level rules adapted without generated files; enum values follow lib/enum/enum.dart.

lib/common/ip_quality_cache.dart.changes: Three-day successful cache and five-minute failure cooldown adapted to native persistence and in-memory pending results; manual retry and nonfatal cache errors preserved.

test/ip_quality_test.dart.changes: Reference provider fixtures and scheduling assertions retained; Dio adapter replaced by a fake transport, with cancellation and quality-level coverage added.

lib/components/profile_card.dart.changes: Profile row height, title strut, selected badge, updating transition and compact update-age labels retained. Uses Room timestamps for local content saves and remote subscription updates; missing timestamps show unknown. Refresh is scoped to visible/resumed pages. Does not invent subscription quotas or expiry badges absent from the native model. Accept a disabled selection callback while retaining the profile metadata and context menu.

sources.changes: IP race concurrency, stagger, response limit, browser user agent and public-IP validation preserved; routed HTTP transport uses sing-box. A source wins only after its source-specific parser validates the public IP and country field; malformed or incomplete responses advance the race.
Eight IP query URLs and source order preserved.
IpInfo response fields adapted to Go JSON/trace parsers.

supplementalReferences.name: mitm-dev
supplementalReferences.scope: Request and MITM certificate design only; the overall UI, Android and sing-box baselines stay unchanged. Local paths are relative to the repository root.

files.changes: GPL-3.0 license included in exported CA modules.
Unmodified installer entry, moved to its ZIP path.
Unmodified installer marker, moved to its ZIP path.

Reference for system/Conscrypt APEX and init/zygote/app mount namespaces. FK-box builds a complete tmpfs copy separately in each target namespace before binding it, retains hash collisions, has no live stale-certificate removal, and logs failures.
Uses the FK-box module-relative injector and resets this boot’s diagnostic log.
Uses the FK-box injector’s --apps option to reach existing app namespaces.

Reference for Android CA identity, hash names, store/namespace limitations and public module export. FK-box implements non-exportable Keystore signing, revision checks and AtomicFile persistence; no automatic root command or private-key export.
Distinguish user/system trust and refresh after returning from settings. FK-box queries its local Android bridge and isolates remote sessions.

Reference for explicit CA operations, HTTPS inclusion/exclusion and certificate setup. FK-box uses private capture settings and shared components; profile HTTP rewriting is a separate FK-box implementation documented in libbox.md. Certificate rotation is blocked while either capture or profile processing uses it; no Mihomo configuration.
Reference for HTTP exchange information. FK-box keeps bounded libbox records and its independent live Connections page.
Reference for per-message detail navigation; FK-box retains its record menu and copyable rows with actual route/TLS metadata and trailers.
FEATURE_MITM is disabled by default in this reference. The public FlClash core is not used as an MITM backend.

supplementalReferences.name: geo-resources
supplementalReferences.scope: Geo data (GeoIP, GeoSite, MMDB, ASN) bundling, update and Resources page design for the Xray and mihomo cores; the overall UI, Android and core baselines stay unchanged. No FlClash source or data file is copied. Local paths are relative to the repository root.

files.changes: Auto update toggle, interval in hours, geo rows with size, last update, single update, URL edit with reset to default and copy link translated to Compose. Icon sets, rule providers, scripts and MITM modules are not carried over; the source (built in or downloaded) is shown beside the time.
Per-resource update with a failure banner and URL validation; updates run in the app through libbox instead of the mihomo core's updater.

initGeo extracts bundled assets into the core home; FK-box also replaces a bundled or downloaded file older than a newer bundle, never a newer download, and checks each extraction against the build's SHA-256.

defaultGeoXUrl (MetaCubeX/meta-rules-dat latest) kept as the default URLs; geo-auto-update off and geo-update-interval 24 hours kept as defaults. The bundled copy is pinned to a meta-rules-dat release-branch commit and verified by SHA-256 at build time instead of being committed.
Same four resources and parser checks as mihomo's updater (protobuf GeoIP/GeoSite, MaxMind DB); the file is written beside the target and renamed so a failed download keeps the old file.

supplementalReferences.name: flclash-record-filters
supplementalReferences.scope: FlClash v0.9.3 list infrastructure (scaffold title menu and keyword chips, record filters, grouping) adapted into the Flutter UI (flutter/).

files.changes: RecordFilter, RecordFacet (offered values by frequency, 12 max, fixed order then name), RecordGrouper, groupRecords and whereFilters (one facet widens, facets narrow).

RecordFilterController as Compose state, removable and pinned keyword lists, Filter and Group by menus (menus close on toggle: fk-box PopupMenuItem has no keepsOpen), RecordFilterScope as a CompositionLocal, recordGroupings saved per page in the interface preferences; RecordGroupedList as a LazyListScope extension with animateItem rows instead of SliverCollapsibleGroups' unfold fade.
titleMenuItems (title opens a popup over its start) and keywords (header strip under the bar; the body no longer runs under the bar while it shows).
_KeywordStrip (36 dp chips, 16 dp inset, 8/20 dp gaps, 4/16 dp padding) and _TitleMenuButton (chevron 20/16 dp, focus overlay only).

RequestsPage with title-menu feeds Recent requests (closed connections, Closed/All menu), Running (active, close-all) and fk-box's Captured HTTP list (sing-box only, greyed with the reason elsewhere; capture menu unchanged); requestFeed persisted; each feed keeps its own search, RecordFilterController and grouping (captured: MITM and app facets, app/host grouping). The connections.dart page is folded in; no per-connection exchange tabs (capture records carry no connection id).

QuickEditPage (monospace text editor with Save, edit guard; a failed apply shows its message with Discard changes? and stays open on cancel; QuickEditCancelled keeps it open) and ListQuickEditPage (one item a line, first three line issues). Hooked into capture HTTPS domains, exclusions, ports and applications, profile mitm.hosts/excluded_hosts, and ConfigListPage object lists as one JSON object a line; saves go through the existing draft/revision-checked setters.

parseListInput (line markup and quotes stripped, comma split, blanks/repeats dropped, max length and validator issues) and parseLineInput (whole lines); the rule-type comma exception, map input and existing-entry counting are not ported (no fk-box field uses them).

note: files and adaptedFiles paths are relative to flutter/ (the Flutter UI module); adaptedNativeFiles and supplementalReferences paths are relative to the repository root.
